about: NFR-SEC-04: reasoned exceptions of tools/check_runtime_downloads.py. 'match' is a substring of the flagged source line; an exception that matches nothing fails the check. 'variant': 'full' entries are ignored by --variant store. Keep this list short; see docs/SECURITY_CHECKS.md.

exceptions.reason: NFR-ROB-04: the warm worker copies the BUNDLED yt-dlp.pyz into its private 0700 work directory (0600, deleted when the worker exits) so a package update mid-session cannot break zipimport offsets. The source is NORDTILE_WORKER_ARCHIVE, which WarmResolver sets from runtimeFile("runtime/yt-dlp.pyz"); the checker verifies that origin as install. Nothing is downloaded.

Same private copy of the bundled archive: `loaded` lives in NORDTILE_WORKER_DIR (WarmResolver's 0700 workDirectory under the cache location), hence the writable/env origin. Only the copy just written from the install is put on sys.path, followed by the worker's own directory and the stdlib; user site and PYTHONPATH are stripped by the host.

The program is the application binary itself (QCoreApplication::applicationFilePath, install) except for the development override SAILTUBE_DEVELOPMENT_YTDLP in main.cpp, an executable a developer names in their own environment. The app never downloads or writes that file; YtDlpRunner::available() requires an absolute, existing, executable path.

The GStreamer library name passes through GstRemuxer's constructor. The only shipped construction is the default GstRemuxer() = "gstreamer-1.0" (main.cpp: `downloads::GstRemuxer remuxer;`), a bare soname the system linker resolves; the name-taking constructor exists for tests.
NFR-SEC-03: makePrivateDir() narrows a private DIRECTORY (the browser-import scratch tree) to 0700; the owner execute bit is the directory search permission. No file is made executable.
PLT-09: makes the app's private flash TMPDIR owner-only (rwx------); the x bit on a directory is traversal, nothing is executed from it.

RES-14 [FULL, opt-in, off by default]: --plugin-dirs points yt-dlp at the user-installed, hash-pinned bgutil plugin under the app's private data dir; never downloaded by the app at run time, refused without a reviewed pin (none is built in for the beta).

RES-14 [FULL, opt-in]: runs the pinned Deno binary (hash-checked against the build's reviewed pin before every start; refused without one) with --deny-write/run/ffi, read only its own directory, and only after the user enables the helper; verified to listen on 127.0.0.1 only.

NFR-MNT-01 [FULL] extractor update (core component), compiled only inside `!sailtube_store { }` (the header #errors on SAILTUBE_STORE). The channel's latest/download URL on github.com, used only for a HEAD that learns the tag (version) and size from the redirect; every hop is re-checked by RedirectChain (https, 443, github.com then the two asset hosts, no user info). Nothing is installed without the signed SHA2-256SUMS (pinned yt-dlp key), the archive checks and the user's confirmation of source, version and size (docs/EXTRACTOR_UPDATE.md).

NFR-MNT-01 [FULL] extractor update (core component), compiled only inside `!sailtube_store { }` (the header #errors on SAILTUBE_STORE). The tagged release URL of the offered version: SHA2-256SUMS, SHA2-256SUMS.sig and the yt-dlp archive. The archive is a zipimport data file that the warm worker imports; it is staged 0600 in a 0700 directory, verified by verify_release.py (detached OpenPGP signature over SHA2-256SUMS by the pinned release key, SHA-256, plain relative zip entries, version) and only then renamed into place; it is never executed or extracted.

NFR-MNT-01 [FULL] extractor update (core component), compiled only inside `!sailtube_store { }` (the header #errors on SAILTUBE_STORE). The allow-list of GitHub's release asset hosts: the only hosts a github.com release download may redirect to. A comparison, not a fetch; the content is verified as for the tagged URL.

NFR-MNT-01 [FULL] extractor update (core component), compiled only inside `!sailtube_store { }` (the header #errors on SAILTUBE_STORE). processVerifier(): the program is the one main.cpp passes, QCoreApplication::applicationFilePath() (install), in its warm-worker mode with NORDTILE_WORKER_TASK=verify, which runs the installed verify_release.py with the installed, pinned key (tests pass python3 -I verify_release.py). The downloaded archive is an input file of the verifier, never a program.

An allow-filter, not a source: only the PO-token manager's --plugin-dirs/youtubepot-* pairs pass to yt-dlp, anything else drops them. On STORE the manager is not compiled and the list is always empty.

Beta builds only: the About page's "Open the download page" button hands this releases page to the system browser (Qt.openUrlExternally). The app itself never fetches it and downloads nothing from it.
